name: price-freshness
description: Asks Catalog & Prices (LC-2246 queue) to refresh an article's prices and stage them in the CMS: say "refresh prices for <article>" in chat, or call mcp__price-freshness__request. Wakes the session with the per-PRID result (ready, or flagged PRIDs first); NOT CHECKED when the queue cannot answer. Warns (never blocks) when a refresh session reads a brand page for a price. Final picks are queued in the database, so headless runs need no mod (LC-2245).
